articles.title: Two Killed in Apache Helicopter Crash Near Salado Causing Fire That Forces Evacuations
articles.excerpt: On Aug. 12, 2026, the Bell County Sheriff's Office reported that the two soldiers killed in an Apache helicopter crash near Salado "were declared deceased by Bell County Justice of the Peace Precinct 2 Michael Tice" (Killeen Daily Herald).

articles.title: Judge Cliff Coleman Announces Resignation Move to Sheriffs Office
articles.excerpt: He succeeded Judge Cliff Coleman, who resigned effective July 20, 2026 to take a position with the Bell County Sheriff's Office (KDH).

articles.title: Sapp Tice to Battle in Precinct Justice of the Peace Runoff
articles.excerpt: In the March 3, 2026 four-way Republican primary, Richard Sapp led with 1,308 votes to Tice's 1,219, sending the two to a runoff (KDH).

articles.title: Low turnout, high stakes: Bell County Republicans lean conservative in runoff election
articles.excerpt: No Democrat filed for the seat (KDH).

articles.title: Patterson Leads Justice of the Peace Precinct Race Sapp Tice Lead Four Way JP
articles.excerpt: Precinct 2 serves Salado, Holland, Bartlett, the lower strip of Belton and the southern part of Bell County (KDH).

articles.title: Four Republicans Vying for Bell County Justice of the Peace Precinct No Primary Election
articles.excerpt: Tice is a Salado resident, a U.S. Army veteran, a former Texas State Trooper and a small business owner (KDH).
